alveolar_selection: clusters ['10', '16'] of the whole-atlas clustering, restricted to the 25-sample annotated cohort, then filtered to author_lineage=='Epithelium' excluding ['Secretory', 'Krt5', 'Ciliated']. 5694 cells. Ciliated and Krt5+ dysplastic compartments are excluded deliberately, as in the source study.
alveolar_embedding: 2000 HVGs recomputed within the compartment (batch_key=sample_id), z-scored, randomized PCA, 30 PCs, n_neighbors=15, Leiden resolution 0.5 -> 12 subclusters
trajectory: PAGA on 12 subclusters, then diffusion pseudotime rooted in subcluster 6 (highest mean AT2 score, AT2 being the known progenitor). Pseudotime is a rank ordering with no units and is not comparable between runs; PAGA edges are connectivity, not flux or rate.
